query:
select role as "role!: Role"
           from map_access
           where map_id = $1
             and subject_id in (
                 select id from characters where user_id = $2
                 union all
                 select corporation_id from characters where user_id = $2
                 union all
                 select alliance_id from characters where user_id = $2 and alliance_id is not null
             )
